title: Faktoranalyse 1974-1975 : Vaardigheidscursus data-analyse
authors: Weegh, P.H.M. op de, Kerssemakers, F.A.M., Hutjes, J.M., Instituut voor toegepaste sociologie, ITS * Nijmegen (primary investigator)
contributors: Instituut voor toegepaste sociologie, ITS * Nijmegen (data collector)
descriptions: A course on data analysis/ in particular factor analysis. For secondary analysis the datasets of two different surveys are used. One of these is also completely stored at Steinmetz Archive under number P0221. The other survey concerns the legal status of underaged persons.
